Name: Better Lao Wu
Author: jiangnan1107
Description:
[size=5][b]Better Lao Wu[/b][/size]

Cats are territorial little gremlins, and now the ones in Stardew Valley are too.

[size=4][b]Standoffs[/b][/size]
When two cats wander within 5 tiles of each other, one of them may take it personally. They stalk in close, go nose to nose, arch their backs, puff up like bottle brushes and hiss it out. A spat lasts about a minute and a half. Mean cats pick fights far more often (40%) than nice ones (10%) - and your own cats are always nice.

[size=4][b]Catfights[/b][/size]
About half of all standoffs boil over into a full-on scrap: a tumbling cloud of dust, paws swiping out of it, scratch marks and little stars - about 20 seconds of chaos. Wander into the cloud and you'll catch a stray swipe (never below 1 HP). Afterwards the two break apart and lick their wounds.

[size=4][b]Stray cats[/b][/size]
Out in the valley (not on your farm), strays sometimes turn up and wander around - at most 3 per map, and they're gone by the end of the day. If there's water nearby they'll crouch on the bank, bat at the surface a few times, and often scoop out a fish.

[size=4][b]Nice cats & mean cats[/b][/size]
Every stray is secretly nice or mean, and they look exactly the same. You'll have to pet them to find out.
[list]
[*][b]Nice cat:[/b] hearts, a happy meow, and the first pet gives you a little speed boost. When it catches a fish, it flings it onto the bank for you.[/*]
[*][b]Mean cat:[/b] it scratches you, you jump out of your skin (yes, just like Lewis and the purple shorts), and it bolts off - picking a fight with any cat it runs into. Its fish? It eats them.[/*]
[/list]Got a fish worth 250g or more? Hold it out to a stray. A nice cat will happily eat it. A mean cat will snatch it and vanish.

[size=4][b]Your horse loves cats[/b][/size]
Ride up to a nice cat and stand still - your horse leans down and gives it a lick, and you get +50% riding speed for 6 minutes. If that cat was fed a pricey fish, the boost lasts all day. Mean cats just glare.
No cats around? Hold some [b]Honey[/b] and interact with your horse for the same 6-minute boost.

[size=4][b]Watering can[/b][/size]
Splash a cat and it sits down to groom itself. Splash two quarrelling cats and the fight's over.

[size=4][b]Tractor Mod (optional)[/b][/size]
If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401]Tractor Mod[/url], driving past a cat gives it a chance to charge the wheels and get squished into a cat pancake. Drive through a catfight and one or both brawlers get flattened - if it's just one, the other freezes in shock. A few seconds later they pop back into shape and stalk off, deeply offended. Cartoon physics - no cats were harmed.

[size=4][b]Sounds[/b][/size]
Comes with real recordings for the standoff, the fight, the healing, the mean cat and the all-day boost. Each part of a quarrel has its own sound and stops when that part ends. The closer you are, the louder it gets.
Want to swap them out, or add your own? Drop .wav or .ogg files into the folders under [i]Mods/CatQuarrel/声音/[/i] (folder names are in Chinese - see README.txt for what each one is). Empty folders fall back to vanilla sounds.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer[/*]
[*]Tractor Mod - optional[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
Unzip into your [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i] folder and launch through SMAPI. Updating from 1.0.0? Just overwrite the old folder.

[size=4][b]Console commands (for testing)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]catfight[/b] - nearest two cats start a standoff, fight after 10 s[/*]
[*][b]catfight fight[/b] - skip straight to the brawl[/*]
[*][b]catfight stop[/b] - end all quarrels[/*]
[*][b]spawncat [n] [good|bad][/b] - spawn temporary cats beside you[/*]
[*][b]wildcat [fish] [good|bad][/b] - spawn a stray nearby[/*]
[*][b]catsquash [2][/b] - next tractor pass guarantees a cat pancake[/*]
[/list][i]Note: SMAPI console messages are in Chinese, and so are the names and tooltips of this mod's buffs.[/i]

Downloads.Description:
Fixes strays getting stuck in your farmhouse. Adds fishing cats, two new buffs, Provoke (H key), peace-making lines and gentle mode.
修复野猫卡在农舍里；新增钓鱼猫、两个新增益、拱火（H 键）、劝架台词和温和模式。

Manifest.Name: 猫咪吵架 (Cat Quarrel)
Manifest.Description: 猫会吵架打架；野猫分好猫坏猫，会捞鱼、能喂鱼；骑马舔猫、喂马蜂蜜得加速；水壶浇猫舔毛；拖拉机压猫饼；钓鱼时猫来蹲守、浇水劝架、按 H 哈气拱火；温和模式开关。
Manifest.Author: yuxaio
